'''Kevin Elia''' (DeckTech handle '''KevOfCrofton'''; Players Committee forum handle '''yavinite'''<ref name="pcf-3279-46119">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46119#46119 Decktech and V cards], Kevin Elia, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625210908/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46730%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>) finished 2nd at [[2002 Yavin 4 Regionals]] with a [[Dark]] [[You May Start Your Landing]] deck.<ref name="dt-22919">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22919 2002 Yavin 4 regional 2nd Place- I Am Jacks Anger], DeckTech (Kevin "KevOfCrofton" Elia, 21 April 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22919/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22919/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009215140/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22919/ Wayback Machine].</ref> He directed the Maryland State Championship in 2005 and again on 17 June 2006 at Renaissance Games in Fallston, Maryland.<ref name="pcf-10140-139455">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=139455#139455 MD States - 6/17/06], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095754/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10140&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> At the [[2006 Dantooine Regional]], [[Thomas Whaley]] went undefeated with an ISB deck that, according to the report, Elia had originally conceived.<ref name="pcf-10157-141541">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541#141541 Dantooine Regionals June 10], aeneas23, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618002138/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141541 Internet Archive]</ref> He also played the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ 2021 Worlds Throwback Event], starwarsccg.org</ref> He finished 2nd at the Coruscant Regional at Mystic Visions 4.12 in Columbia, Pennsylvania, on 11 December 2004 with Profit and Walkers,<ref name="pcf-4120-58215" /> and 5th of 15 at the Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier at Neutral Ground on 8 January 2005.<ref name="pcf-4273-59872" />
